caption: The drawing features a stylized bird perched on a large, decorative floral arrangement. The bird is colored in yellow and red, with a black beak, a round red eye, a red heart-shaped marking on its wing, and a tail consisting of red and yellow striped feathers. The bird faces left and appears to be pecking at a red and yellow flower on the left side of the composition. The floral arrangement includes several flowers and leaves, predominantly in red, yellow, and black. One large, red-outlined flower with yellow interior sits to the left of the bird, while a geometric, star-shaped red flower with a yellow, crosshatched center is on the right. The stems and leaves are mostly black with yellow patterns, and the entire composition is set within a red, semicircular base that curves at the bottom of the drawing. The background is off-white or beige, and there is a small, centered label at the bottom of the artwork.
title: Drawing for Plate 14: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
